program.name: Tabata Hourglass
program.subject: Conditioning
program.blurb: Rounds of Tabatas, then a ladder one day and an AMRAP the next.
program.about: Tabatas first, twenty seconds hard and ten seconds rest, eight times over, three of them in a row. Then one day climbs a ladder of a lift and a cardio move, and the other runs an AMRAP. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder variations.
program.split: Tabatas, then a ladder / Tabatas, then an AMRAP
